signIn.errorFailed: Sign in failed. Please try again.

access.deniedBody: Creator Studio is currently available by invitation. If you believe you should have access, please reach out to the Inigo team.
access.errorTitle: We could not confirm your access

access.signInDifferent: Sign in with a different account

home.createTitle: Create guided experiences that help people practice.
home.createLede: Pass something meaningful forward through Inigo.
home.sessionsLede: Pick up where you left off.
home.challengesLede: Drafts, versions in review, and approved versions.
home.recipesLede: Drafts, versions in review, and approved recipes.
home.noAreasBody: Your Studio account is active, but no creation area is available for it yet.

capability.guidedSessionsBody: This account can open Studio, but it doesn't include guided sessions.

challenges.unavailableBody: This account can open Studio, but it doesn't include challenges.
challenges.listLede: Open a challenge to keep editing, or send a draft for review.
challenges.emptyBody: Create a challenge to give people a sequence of practices.
challenges.invalidId: This challenge address is not valid.
challenges.daysPerWeekLede: On how many separate days each week should the task be completed? Several completions on the same day count as one day.
challenges.daysPerWeekMore: Each person's week starts on the day they join. Extra days do not carry into the next week.
challenges.scheduleOngoingLede: The challenge continues with no set end date, until the participant chooses to stop.
challenges.scheduleFixedLede: The challenge ends after the number of weeks you choose.
challenges.stepsTitle: What do you practice each day?
challenges.stepsLede: Choose one practice, or a sequence of up to five. Participants repeat the same task on each practice day — practices are not split across different days of the week. If you choose a sequence, the whole sequence must be completed in order for the day to count.
challenges.stepsOrderLede: Changing the order sets the order people follow.
challenges.kindSilentLede: Choose meditation, walking, or breathing, and the practice time required.
challenges.kindGuidedLede: Choose a free session from the library. You can also choose sessions from other guides. Completing the practice in the challenge requires the session to end naturally.
challenges.summaryDaily: The task on each practice day:
challenges.summaryGoalOngoing: Goal: {days}, with no set end date.
challenges.pendingNote: This version is waiting for review, so it cannot be edited.
challenges.approvedNote: This approved version stays as it is. Saving a revision opens a new draft.
challenges.newVersionNote: A new version is for people who join after it is approved. People already participating stay on their current version.
challenges.coverLede: You can add an image that gives the challenge a character. Without an image, Inigo will show a suitable illustration.
challenges.coverOptional: An image is not required for saving or submitting.
challenges.coverLimits: JPEG, PNG, or WEBP, up to 15MB.
challenges.coverLimitsMore: Up to 10,000 pixels on a side, and up to 40 million pixels. The image is stored on the server.
challenges.coverPublicNote: The public image changes only after the new version is approved.

coverIssue.type: Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image.
coverIssue.edge: One side is longer than 10,000 pixels.
coverIssue.pixels: The image has more than 40 million pixels.

errors.versionNotEditable: A version waiting for review cannot be edited.
errors.permission: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.coverUpload: The image upload failed. You can try again on the same challenge.
errors.coverRetry: The challenge was saved, but the image was not uploaded. You can try again without creating another challenge.
errors.image: The image is not a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP, or it is larger than allowed.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. You can try again.

challenges.archiveBody: People will no longer be able to join it. The challenge itself stays in your list.

issue.title: Add at least one title, in Hebrew or English.
issue.days: Choose from 1 to 7 practice days each week.
issue.week_count: A fixed schedule needs a whole number of weeks greater than zero.
issue.practice_type: Each quiet step needs a practice type.
issue.duration_minutes: Each quiet step needs a duration from 1 to 180 minutes.
issue.guided_session: Each guided step needs a session chosen from the list.

recipes.unavailableBody: This account can open Studio, but it doesn't include recipes.
recipes.emptyBody: Create a recipe to share it in the library.
recipes.invalidId: This recipe address is not valid.
recipes.pasteLede: Write a recipe idea or paste an existing recipe. We will prepare instructions you can copy into ChatGPT or another AI tool.
recipes.pasteRequestLabel: What recipe would you like to make?
recipes.pasteRequestPlaceholder: A lentil salad for four, ready in 20 minutes, with simple ingredients
recipes.pasteRequestMissing: Write what you want to make before copying.
recipes.pasteStep1: Write what you want to make and copy the request.
recipes.pasteStep2: Paste it into ChatGPT or another AI tool and send it.
recipes.pasteStep3: Copy the result and paste it here for review.
recipes.copyPrompt: Copy the request and the instructions
recipes.promptCopied: The request was copied. Paste it into a chat with the AI tool and send it. Paste the reply you receive in the area below.
recipes.pasteCopyManual: We could not copy automatically. Select the instructions and copy them.
recipes.pasteLabel: The result you received from the AI tool
recipes.pasteReviewNote: Pasting does not save or publish the recipe. After review you can add an image, save, and submit it for approval.
recipes.previewLanguageMissing: This language is missing from the recipe. You can complete it in Edit details.
recipes.importReplaceBody: The current content will be replaced by the pasted recipe. The image will stay.

importIssue.empty: Paste the recipe the tool returned.
importIssue.notJson: This result cannot be shown as a recipe. Copy the prompt again and ask the tool to return the recipe in the requested format.
importIssue.multipleBlocks: Paste one reply only, with a single recipe.
importIssue.notObject: The result is not a single recipe. Ask the tool for one recipe.
importIssue.forbidden: The result includes details the site fills in itself, such as an image or a status. Ask for a recipe without those fields.
importIssue.unknownField: The result includes a field that does not belong in the recipe. Ask the tool to return only the recipe structure.
importIssue.type: Some fields are in the wrong format. Ask the tool to return the recipe again.
importIssue.number: Time and servings need to be whole numbers.
importIssue.mealType: The meal type is not in the allowed list. Ask the tool to use one of the allowed types.
importIssue.timeSuitability: The times of day are not in the allowed list. Ask the tool to use only the allowed times.
importIssue.dietaryTags: The dietary label is not in the allowed list. If none was given, leave the list empty.
importIssue.ingredients: Every ingredient needs an amount and a name. Check the ingredient list.
importIssue.steps: Every step needs text. Check the preparation steps.
importIssue.language: One complete language is required: a title, every ingredient name, and every step in that language.
importIssue.sourceUrl: The source address needs to be a full link, or stay empty when there is no source.
importIssue.tooLong: One of the fields is too long. Shorten it and ask for the recipe again.
importIssue.illustration: The illustration mark needs to be yes or no.

recipes.partialDraft: You can save a partial draft.
recipes.titleLede: You can fill in one language, or both.
recipes.titleMore: Submission needs at least one language with a title, every ingredient name, and every step. A description and a translation into the other language are optional.
recipes.descriptionLede: A description and a translation into another language are optional.
recipes.creditLede: The name shown beside the recipe. You can name a creator or the Inigo team.
recipes.creditMore: The credit does not change ownership.
recipes.imageOwnLede: Choose a photo of the dish from your device.
recipes.imageAiLede: We will prepare an image request that matches the recipe. Copy it into ChatGPT or an image tool, then upload the image you receive here.
recipes.imageCopiedStep1: Paste it into the same AI chat where you prepared the recipe, or into a new chat.
recipes.imageCopiedStep2: Ask it to create the image and download the image to your device.
recipes.imageCopyManual: We could not copy automatically. Select the request and copy it.
recipes.imageAiIllustration: An image made with AI is shown as an illustration.
recipes.imageGapIntro: To prepare an image request, complete:
recipes.coverLede: JPEG, PNG, or WEBP, up to 15MB.
recipes.coverMore: Up to 10,000 pixels on a side, and up to 40 million pixels. The image is stored on the server.
recipes.coverPending: The selected image is not saved yet.
recipes.illustrationLede: Check this if the image is an illustration, for example an image made with AI.
recipes.illustrationMore: This mark stays with this version.
recipes.totalMinutesLede: The time includes waiting, cooking, or cooling until the dish is ready.
recipes.totalMinutesMore: One number for the whole recipe, in minutes.
recipes.servingsLede: How many portions this recipe makes.
recipes.dietaryLede: Mark this only if the recipe is vegetarian or vegan. Recipes with meat or fish are welcome too — leave this unmarked.
recipes.dietaryMore: Marking vegetarian does not mark the recipe vegan, and the reverse.
recipes.ingredientsLede: A name in each language, and the amount as text. List order is the display order.
recipes.stepsLede: Text in each language. List order is the cooking order.
recipes.sourceLede: The source name and link are optional.
recipes.pendingNote: This version is waiting for review, so it can't be edited.
recipes.approvedNote: An update to an approved recipe is shown publicly only after it is approved.
recipes.archiveBody: The recipe will leave the library. It stays in your list.
recipes.unarchiveTitle: Return this recipe to the library?
recipes.unarchiveBody: An approved recipe will show in the library again.
recipes.unarchived: The recipe is back in the library.

coverIssue.type: Use a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image.
coverIssue.edge: One side is longer than 10,000 pixels.
coverIssue.pixels: The image has more than 40 million pixels.

submitIssue.cover: Submission needs a saved cover image.
submitIssue.total_minutes: Submission needs a total time of at least 1 minute.
submitIssue.servings: Submission needs at least one serving.
submitIssue.credit: Submission needs a credit in Hebrew or English.
submitIssue.ingredients: Submission needs at least one ingredient with an amount.
submitIssue.steps: Submission needs at least one step.
submitIssue.language: Submission needs one complete language: a title, a name for every ingredient, and text for every step.
submitIssue.source_url: The source link must be an http or https address.

errors.versionNotEditable: A version waiting for review can't be edited.
errors.notPublished: Only an approved recipe can return to the library.
errors.permission: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.coverUpload: The image upload failed. You can try again on the same draft.
errors.coverRetry: The details were saved, but the image was not uploaded. You can try again without creating another recipe.
errors.titleHe: The Hebrew name is too long or is not text.
errors.titleEn: The English name is too long or is not text.
errors.descriptionHe: The Hebrew description is too long or is not text.
errors.descriptionEn: The English description is too long or is not text.
errors.creditHe: The Hebrew credit is too long or is not text.
errors.creditEn: The English credit is too long or is not text.
errors.credit: Add a credit in Hebrew or English.
errors.sourceName: The source name is too long or is not text.
errors.sourceUrl: The source link must be an http or https address.
errors.illustration: The illustration mark must be yes or no.
errors.totalMinutes: Total time must be a whole number of minutes, or stay empty on a draft.
errors.servings: Servings must be a whole number, or stay empty on a draft.
errors.mealType: That dish type is not recognized.
errors.timeSuitability: One of the times of day is not recognized.
errors.dietaryTags: One of the dietary labels is not recognized.
errors.ingredients: The ingredient list is not valid.
errors.steps: The step list is not valid.
errors.image: The image is not a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP, or it is over the size limit.
errors.language: One complete language is required: a title, a name for every ingredient, and text for every step.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

create.guidedSessionDesc: Create a guided practice for the Inigo library.
create.challengeDesc: A sequence of quiet and guided practices people can join.
create.recipeDesc: Share a recipe in the Inigo library.
create.insightDesc: Share a reflection, note, or teaching.
create.practiceDesc: Share a simple breathing, movement, or daily exercise.
create.resourceDesc: Share something meaningful: music, recipe, book, or ritual.

sessions.emptyText: When you create a guided session, it will appear here so you can pick up where you left off.
sessions.emptyFilteredText: Try another filter, or create something new in the Create tab.

createForm.title: Create guided session
createForm.lede: Start with the basics. You can refine everything later.
createForm.defaultsNote: Instructor, environment, and music are set to calm defaults for now — you can refine them later.
createForm.successBody: "{title}" is saved as a draft. Continue setup now, or come back later from Studio.

publish.cooldownWithTime: You can publish your next session after {time}.
publish.cooldownNoTime: You can publish your next session again soon.
publish.limitTitle: You've reached your current publishing limit.
publish.limitBody: You can archive an existing published session or contact Inigo.
publish.readyLede: Everything required is ready. Submit when you are ready for the Inigo team to review.
publish.notReadyLede: Complete the missing items before submitting.
publish.confirmText: Your session will be sent to the Inigo team for review. After publishing, you can't change the content. Once approved, it will appear in the Inigo library and you can share the public link.
publish.noAccess: You do not have access to publish this session.
publish.submittedText: Your session has been submitted. The Inigo team will review it before it goes live in the library. You will be able to share the public link after approval.
publish.publishedText: This session is live in Inigo. You can replace the video or audio from Media — the current version stays available until a new one is approved. Other details stay as they are for now.

editor.noAccessEdit: You do not have access to edit this session.
editor.contentReadonly: Submitted and archived sessions are read-only in Studio.
editor.liveDetailsNote: Some session details can't be changed after publishing.
editor.liveFieldReadOnly: That change couldn't be saved. Some session details can't be changed after publishing.
editor.welcomeHint: Add your audio next — it is required before you can publish.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lede: A quick read on what you are creating — details live in Content.
overview.draftIncompleteLede: Complete the steps below to publish.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What will someone feel or learn in this session?
fields.timeSuitabilityHelper: When does this practice fit best? This helps Inigo choose a more relevant invitation during the day.

hints.description: What someone will feel or learn. This appears in the library and when sharing.
hints.voice: Preferred voice style for guided audio, when recorded.
hints.difficulty: Helps people choose a session that matches their experience.
hints.practice: The practice type — meditation, breathing, yoga, and so on. Used for browsing.
hints.focus: The emotional theme or intention — how the session feels in the library.
hints.instructor: The name shown as the guide for this session.
hints.environment: The setting or atmosphere — e.g. indoor, outdoor, nature.
hints.backgroundMusic: The mood or style of background sound — e.g. ambient, silence.
hints.backgroundMusicCreator: Optional credit for the music or sound used.
hints.accessTier: Who can access this session in the app — free or paid tiers.
hints.tags: Optional keywords for discovery. Separate with commas.

duration.label: Duration
duration.helper: This will be updated automatically after you upload audio or video.

media.title: Media
media.lede: Add either audio or video, plus a required cover image. Use the size and dimension tips under each slot for the best look in the app.
media.liveLede: This is the version people currently get in Inigo.
media.readonly: Media can only be changed while this session is a draft.
media.hintAudio: Add the guided audio for this session.
media.hintCover: Required before publishing. Helps people recognize your session.
media.hintAudioBlocked: Remove the current video first, then you can add audio.
media.hintVideoBlocked: Remove the current audio first, then you can add video.
media.hintPrimaryConflict: Both audio and video are attached. Remove one to continue.
media.primaryConflict: This session has both audio and video. Remove one to continue.
media.uploadFlowNote: When you choose a file, it uploads to secure storage immediately, then links to your draft. Removing a file deletes it from storage.
media.confirmRemoveBody: The file will be deleted from storage and unlinked from this draft.
media.recommendedCover: Best look in the app: 16:9, at least 1280×720 (ideal 1920×1080)
media.autoOptimizeNote: Inigo automatically optimizes uploaded video for playback.
media.optimizingHint: Optimizing in the background — you can keep working on this session.
media.optimizeFailedHint: Optimization did not finish. You can retry, or replace the video.
media.audioUnsupported: Your browser does not support audio playback.

replacement.awaitingReviewBody: Your current approved version remains available until the new version is approved.
replacement.rejectedBody: Your current version is still live.
replacement.cancelledBody: Your current version is still live.
replacement.promoted: The new version is now live.
replacement.discardNote: This removes only the proposed replacement. The live version stays available.
replacement.wrongType: Choose a file that matches this session. Video stays video, and audio stays audio.
replacement.extensionMismatch: This file doesn't match the upload already started. Discard that replacement to choose a different file.
replacement.alreadyOpen: A replacement is already in progress.
replacement.stale: This upload is out of date. Showing the latest status.
replacement.invalidState: This replacement changed. Showing the latest status.
replacement.validation: That file could not be used. Check the format and try again.
replacement.uploadFailed: Upload didn't finish. You can try the same file again.
replacement.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mediaError.config: File uploads are not configured yet. Contact your Studio admin.
mediaError.auth: Your session expired. Please sign in again and try again.
mediaError.attachPending: Upload completed, but attaching it to the session failed.
mediaError.attach: The media uploaded successfully, but could not be attached to this session. Please try again.
mediaError.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
mediaError.noPermission: You do not have permission to upload media for this session.
mediaError.exclusivePrimaryMedia: Only one of audio or video is allowed for each session.

mediaValidation.tooLarge: This file is too large. Please choose one under {maxMb} MB.
mediaValidation.tooLargeVideo: This file is too large. Please choose a video under 2 GB.
mediaValidation.audioFormat: Please upload an MP3 or M4A audio file.
mediaValidation.videoFile: Please choose an MP4 or MOV video file.
mediaValidation.exclusivePrimaryMedia: Only one of audio or video is allowed for each session.
mediaValidation.removeOtherPrimaryFirst: Remove the other media type first, then add this one.

preview.title: Preview
preview.lede: A glimpse of how this session may feel in the Inigo library.
preview.descriptionPlaceholder: Your description will appear here in the library.
preview.mediaConflict: Audio and video attached — keep only one
preview.mediaNone: Add audio or video in Media
preview.notePrimary: Add audio or video in Media to complete the experience preview.
preview.notePrimaryConflict: Remove either audio or video in Media — only one is allowed.
preview.noteVideoOptimizing: Video is being prepared for playback. Preview uses the current ready video when available.
preview.noteVideoFailed: Video optimization failed. Retry from Media, or replace the file.
preview.noteCover: A cover image is required before you can publish this session.
preview.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support video playback.

validation.title: Please add a title.
validation.description: Description should be at least a few words.
validation.timeSuitability: Please choose when this practice fits best.
